subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After rebasing and exact-head checks, should the privileged workflow owners accept these 14 action updates as one grouped dependency change?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but it replaces third-party executable code in secret-bearing, security-scanning, release, and repository-automation workflows; CI cannot decide whether maintainers accept that grouped trust-boundary change.

options.title: Approve the refreshed group
options.body: Rebase, verify the reduced exact diff and green security and release gates, then approve the grouped SHA-pinned updates.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing action bumps so owners can review and land each trust boundary independently.

recommendation.title: Approve the refreshed group
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify the reduced exact diff and green security and release gates, then approve the grouped SHA-pinned updates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to the central Docker release and full-release-validation workflows affected by the group.
